outbox_events_pending_idx.name: outbox_events_pending_idx
outbox_events_pending_idx.where: processed_at is null and failed_at is null

rec_applications_score_chk.name: rec_applications_score_chk
rec_applications_score_chk.value: score is null or score between 0 and 100

rec_jobs_salary_chk.name: rec_jobs_salary_chk
rec_jobs_salary_chk.value: salary_min is null or salary_max is null or salary_max >= salary_min

sales_register_sessions_closed_chk.name: sales_register_sessions_closed_chk
sales_register_sessions_closed_chk.value: status = 'open' or (closed_at is not null and counted_cash is not null and closing is not null)

sales_register_sessions_period_chk.name: sales_register_sessions_period_chk
sales_register_sessions_period_chk.value: closed_at is null or closed_at >= opened_at

store_orders_total_chk.name: store_orders_total_chk
store_orders_total_chk.value: total = subtotal + delivery_fee and subtotal >= 0 and delivery_fee >= 0

store_orders_completed_chk.name: store_orders_completed_chk
store_orders_completed_chk.value: status <> 'completed' or sale_id is not null

store_orders_cancelled_chk.name: store_orders_cancelled_chk
store_orders_cancelled_chk.value: status <> 'cancelled' or cancel_reason is not null

store_orders_address_chk.name: store_orders_address_chk
store_orders_address_chk.value: fulfillment <> 'delivery' or address is not null or customer_phone is null
